title: Why Farmed Fish Quietly Took Over Your Plate
hook: Your salmon never saw the ocean -- farms now grow 94 million tonnes.
closing: The ocean didn't get emptier. It got outcompeted.
question: Would you notice if your fish was farmed?

segments.say: In 1990 almost every fish was wild-caught; by 2022 farms produced 94 million tonnes.
In 2022, farmed fish finally edged past wild-caught, taking 51 percent of the catch.
Now 57 percent of the fish on your plate comes from a farm.
